## Procedure

- Run `git log origin/main --oneline --grep "Remudero-Task: W1-T<n>$" -1` and confirm it prints nothing.
- Run `git ls-remote origin "refs/rmd-dispatch/W1-T<n>"` and `git ls-remote --heads origin | grep "W1-T<n>-"` and confirm both print nothing. A hit means the fleet holds or built the task: stop and report it.
- Run `./bin/rmd claim W1-T<n>` once. Never claim again later: a second claim of a held ref runs every pre-push check and then fails as "taken".
- Run `git -C <base repo> ls-tree --name-only origin/main plan/tasks.d/ | grep "^plan/tasks.d/W1-T<n>-"` and wait until the task file is on main (`waitship.sh <n>` on the Mac, `azwaitship.sh <n>` for an Azure build; `AFTER_PR=<number>` first waits for an amendment PR to merge).
- Run the three scope checks again just before the push: the fleet may have built and merged the task while the build waited (W1-T13709).
- Run `node ~/rmd-work/bin/mkbody.mjs <why-file> code plan/tasks.d/W1-T<n>-<slug>.yaml > <body>` and then `./bin/rmd check-acceptance <body>`.
- Run `shipmac.sh <n>` for a Mac build, or `shipbuilt.sh <n>` for an Azure build. Both start `ship.sh`, which runs the quick check, reruns failed tests alone (FLAKE when green alone, REAL when red alone), pushes, opens the PR and checks the stored body.
- Run `watchmine.sh <minutes> "W1-T<n>"` and act on SETTLED-RED or MERGED.
- Open the PR's commits before any hand fix: when the fleet fix bot has pushed a repair, do not start a second fixer.

Boundaries: no `--no-verify`, no force-push, no `git stash`, no hand ref deletion. A Codex hold before publish is reported, never released by hand. Before shipping a Mac-built test, confirm it uses `git init -b main` (and `git clone --branch main`) and deletes an env var that was unset instead of assigning `undefined`: the Linux lane runs git 2.43.

## Evidence

- Azure ship logs (322 histories): 218 "PR ... open" lines, 186 MERGED lines, 25 "already on origin; not claiming again" lines, 14 FLAKE and 10 REAL triage verdicts.
- Mac ship logs: 314 "preflight passed; pushing" lines.
- Sources: ~/rmd-hand/BUILD-RULES.md, ~/rmd-work/rules/BUILD-RULES-AZURE.md, shipmac.sh, waitship.sh, azwaitship.sh, shipbuilt.sh, ship.sh, watchmine.sh.
